blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Three people, including two 16-year-olds, were arrested in separate operations in South Cotabato province over social media posts and videos that allegedly threatened or frightened residents, particularly students and parents, Gov. Reynaldo S. Tamayo Jr. said Monday. In a post on his official social media page Monday morning, Tamayo said the two minors were arrested in Barangay Lamian, Surallah, on Sunday after authorities traced threatening content posted online. Tamayo said authorities were preparing charges against the two minors, but would first need clearance from the Department of Social Welfare and Development because of their age.
